texts.title_ja: チョーサー『騎士の物語』冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Whilom, as olde stories tellen us,
Ther was a duc that highte Theseus;
Of Atthenes he was lord and governour,
And in his tyme swich a conquerour

texts.title_ja: チョーサー『粉屋の物語』冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Whilom ther was dwellynge at Oxenford
A riche gnof, that gestes heeld to bord,
And of his craft he was a carpenter

texts.title_ja: チョーサー『バースの女房の前口上』
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Experience, though noon auctoritee
Were in this world, is right ynogh for me
To speke of wo that is in mariage

texts.title_ja: チョーサー『免罪符売りの物語』
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
In Flaundres whilom was a compaignye
Of yonge folk, that haunteden folye,
As riot, hasard, stywes, and tavernes

texts.title_ja: チョーサー『トロイラスとクリセイデ』冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
The double sorwe of Troilus to tellen,
That was the kyng Priamus sone of Troye,
In lovynge, how his aventures fellen
Fro wo to wele, and after out of joye

texts.title_ja: ラングランド『農夫ピアズ』
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
In a somer seson, whan softe was the sonne,
I shoop me into shroudes as I a sheep weere,
In habite as an heremite unholy of werkes,
Wente wide in this world wondres to here

texts.title_ja: 中英語『梟とナイチンゲール』
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Ich was in one sumere dale,
In one suþe diʒele hale,
Iherde ich holde grete tale

texts.title_ja: ミルトン『失楽園』第2巻
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
High on a Throne of Royal State, which far
Outshon the wealth of Ormus and of Ind,
Or where the gorgeous East with richest hand
Showrs on her Kings Barbaric Pearl and Gold

texts.title_ja: ミルトン『失楽園』第4巻
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Sweet is the breath of morn, her rising sweet,
With charm of earliest birds; pleasant the sun
When first on this delightful land he spreads

texts.title_ja: ミルトン「盲目を嘆く」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
When I consider how my light is spent
Ere half my days in this dark world and wide,
And that one Talent which is death to hide
Lodged with me useless

texts.title_original: Donne - For Whom the Bell Tolls (Meditation 17)
texts.title_ja: ダン「誰がために鐘は鳴る」（瞑想17）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt: No man is an island, entire of itself; every man is a piece of the continent, a part of the main

texts.title_ja: ハーバート「復活祭」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Rise heart; thy Lord is risen. Sing his praise
Without delayes,
Who takes thee by the hand, that thou likewise
With him mayst rise

texts.title_ja: ハーバート「滑車」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
When God at first made man,
Having a glass of blessings standing by,
'Let us,' said he, 'pour on him all we can:
Let the world's riches, which dispersed lie

texts.title_ja: マーヴェル「庭」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
How vainly men themselves amaze
To win the palm, the oak, or bays;
And their uncessant labors see
Crowned from some single herb or tree

texts.title_ja: ヴォーン「世界」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I saw Eternity the other night
Like a great ring of pure and endless light,
All calm, as it was bright

texts.title_ja: トラハーン「感謝」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
The corn was orient and immortal wheat,
Which never should be reaped, nor was ever sown.
I thought it had stood from everlasting

texts.title_ja: クラショー「泣き女」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Hail, sister springs!
Parents of silver-footed rills!
Ever bubbling things

texts.title_ja: ヘリック「処女たちへ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Gather ye rosebuds while ye may,
Old Time is still a-flying;
And this same flower that smiles today
Tomorrow will be dying

texts.title_ja: ヘリック「コリンナの五月遊び」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Get up, get up for shame, the blooming morn
Upon her wings presents the god unshorn.
See how Aurora throws her fair

texts.title_original: Lovelace - To Lucasta, Going to the Wars
texts.title_ja: ラヴレース「戦に行くルカスタへ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Tell me not, sweet, I am unkind,
That from the nunnery
Of thy chaste breast and quiet mind
To war and arms I fly

texts.title_ja: サックリング「なぜそんなに青ざめて」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Why so pale and wan, fond lover?
Prithee, why so pale?
Will, when looking well can't move her,
Looking ill prevail?

texts.title_original: Dryden - To the Memory of Mr. Oldham
texts.title_ja: ドライデン「オールダム氏の追悼に」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Farewell, too little, and too lately known,
Whom I began to think and call my own:
For sure our souls were near allied, and thine
Cast in the same poetic mould with mine

texts.title_original: Pope - Rape of the Lock III
texts.title_ja: ポープ『髪盗み』第3歌
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Close by those meads, for ever crowned with flowers,
Where Thames with pride surveys his rising towers,
There stands a structure of majestic frame

texts.title_ja: ポープ『鈍人列伝』
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
The Mighty Mother, and her Son, who brings
The Smithfield Muses to the Ear of Kings,
I sing

texts.title_original: Blake - Marriage of Heaven and Hell - Proverbs of Hell
texts.title_ja: ブレイク『天国と地獄の結婚』「地獄の格言」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
The road of excess leads to the palace of wisdom.
Proverbs of Hell.
In seed time learn, in harvest teach, in winter enjoy.

texts.title_ja: ブレイク『無垢の歌』序
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Piping down the valleys wild,
Piping songs of pleasant glee,
On a cloud I saw a child,
And he laughing said to me

texts.title_ja: ブレイク「聖木曜日」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
'Twas on a Holy Thursday, their innocent faces clean,
The children walking two and two, in red, and blue, and green:
Grey-headed beadles walked before, with wands as white as snow,
Till into the high dome of Paul's they like Thames waters flow

texts.title_original: Byron - So We'll Go No More A-Roving
texts.title_ja: バイロン「もう散歩には行きまい」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
So, we'll go no more a-roving
So late into the night,
Though the heart be still as loving,
And the moon be still as bright

texts.title_ja: バイロン「海への呼びかけ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Roll on, thou deep and dark blue Ocean—roll!
Ten thousand fleets sweep over thee in vain;
Man marks the earth with ruin—his control
Stops with the shore

texts.title_original: Browning - Pippa Passes - 'God's in His Heaven'
texts.title_ja: ブラウニング「ピッパが通る」「神は天におわす」
エマソン「コンコード讃歌」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
By the rude bridge that arched the flood,
Their flag to April's breeze unfurled,
Here once the embattled farmers stood,
And fired the shot heard round the world

texts.title_ja: ソロー「霊感」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I am a parcel of vain strivings tied
By a chance bond together,
Dangling this way and that, their links

texts.title_ja: ディキンソン「希望は羽あるもの」全文
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
"Hope" is the thing with feathers –
That perches in the soul –
And sings the tune without the words –
And never stops – at all –

texts.title_ja: ディキンソン「私は誰でもない」全文
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I'm Nobody! Who are you?
Are you – Nobody – too?
Then there's a pair of us!
Don't tell! they'd advertise – you know!

texts.title_ja: ディキンソン「私は可能性に住む」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I dwell in Possibility –
A fairer House than Prose –
More numerous of Windows –
Superior – for Doors –

texts.title_original: Lear - The Owl and the Pussycat
texts.title_ja: エドワード・リア「梟と猫」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
The Owl and the Pussy-cat went to sea
In a beautiful pea-green boat,
They took some honey, and plenty of money,
Wrapped up in a five-pound note

texts.title_ja: キャロル「ジャバウォッキー」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
'Twas brillig, and the slithy toves
Did gyre and gimble in the wabe;
All mimsy were the borogoves,
And the mome raths outgrabe

texts.title_ja: キプリング「ガンガ・ディン」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
You may talk o' gin and beer
When you're quartered safe out 'ere,
An' you're sent to penny-fights an' Aldershot it;
But when it comes to slaughter

texts.title_ja: イェイツ「ラピス・ラズリ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I have heard that hysterical women say
They are sick of the palette and fiddle-bow,
Of poets that are always gay

texts.title_original: Yeats - No Country for Old Men
texts.title_ja: イェイツ「老人の国にあらず」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
That is no country for old men. The young
In one another's arms, birds in the trees,
—Those dying generations—at their song

texts.title_ja: エリオット「マリーナ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
What seas what shores what grey rocks and what islands
What water lapping the bow
And scent of pine and the woodthrush singing through the fog

texts.title_ja: エリオット「東方の博士の旅」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Then at dawn we came down to a temperate valley,
Wet, below the snow line, smelling of vegetation,
With a running stream and a water-mill

texts.title_ja: パウンド「玉階の怨」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
The jewelled steps are already quite white with dew,
It is so late that the dew soaks my gauze stockings,
And I let down the crystal curtain
And watch the moon through the clear autumn

texts.title_original: Stevens - Idea of Order at Key West
texts.title_ja: スティーヴンス「キー・ウェストでの秩序の観念」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
She sang beyond the genius of the sea.
The water never formed to mind or voice,
Like a body wholly body, fluttering

texts.title_ja: ウィリアムズ「論考」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I will teach you my townspeople
how to perform a funeral,
for you have it over a troop of artists

texts.title_ja: ウィリアムズ『パタソン』第2巻
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Outside
outside myself
there is a world

texts.title_ja: フロスト「火と氷」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Some say the world will end in fire,
Some say in ice.
From what I've tasted of desire
I hold with those who favor fire.

texts.title_ja: フロスト「金は留まれず」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Nature's first green is gold,
Her hardest hue to hold.
Her early leaf's a flower;
But only so an hour.

texts.title_ja: ジェファーズ「輝け、滅びゆく共和国」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
While this America settles in the mould of its vulgarity, heavily thickening to empire,
And protest, only a bubble in the molten mass, pops and sighs out

texts.title_ja: ボードレール「夕の和声」
ボードレール「髪」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Ô toison, moutonnant jusque sur l'encolure!
Ô boucles! Ô parfum chargé de nonchaloir!
Extase! Pour peupler ce soir l'alcôve obscure
Des souvenirs dormant dans cette chevelure

texts.title_ja: ボードレール「読者へ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
La sottise, l'erreur, le péché, la lésine,
Occupent nos esprits et travaillent nos corps,
Et nous alimentons nos aimables remords,
Comme les mendiants nourrissent leur vermine

texts.title_ja: ランボー「悪しき血」（地獄の季節）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt: J'ai de mes ancêtres gaulois l'œil bleu blanc, la cervelle étroite, et la maladresse dans la lutte

texts.title_ja: ヴェルレーヌ「私のなじみの夢」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Je fais souvent ce rêve étrange et pénétrant
D'une femme inconnue, et que j'aime, et qui m'aime,
Et qui n'est, chaque fois, ni tout à fait la même
Ni tout à fait une autre, et m'aime et me comprend

texts.title_ja: マラルメ「現出」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
La lune s'attristait. Des séraphins en pleurs
Rêvant, l'archet aux doigts, dans le calme des fleurs
Vaporeuses, tiraient de mourantes violes
De blancs sanglots glissant sur l'azur des corolles

texts.title_ja: アポリネール「ミラボー橋」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Sous le pont Mirabeau coule la Seine
Et nos amours
Faut-il qu'il m'en souvienne
La joie venait toujours après la peine

texts.title_ja: エリュアール「自由」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Sur mes cahiers d'écolier
Sur mon pupitre et les arbres
Sur le sable sur la neige
J'écris ton nom

texts.title_ja: ブルトン「自由なる結合」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Ma femme à la chevelure de feu de bois
Aux pensées d'éclairs de chaleur
À la taille de sablier

texts.title_original: Aragon - Il n'y a pas d'amour heureux
texts.title_ja: アラゴン「幸福な愛などない」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Rien n'est jamais acquis à l'homme
Ni sa force
Ni sa faiblesse ni son cœur

texts.title_ja: プレヴェール「朝食」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Il a mis le café
Dans la tasse
Il a mis le lait

texts.title_ja: ペソア（カエイロ）『羊飼い』IX
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Sou um guardador de rebanhos.
O rebanho é os meus pensamentos
E os meus pensamentos são todos sensações.
Penso com os olhos e com os ouvidos

texts.title_ja: ペソア（レイス）「オード17」
ペソア（カンポス）「海洋頌歌」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Sozinho, no cais deserto, a esta manhã de Verão,
Olho pró lado da barra, olho pró Indefinido,
Olho e contenta-me ver

texts.title_ja: ロルカ「黒馬」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
En la luna negra
de los bandoleros,
cantan las espuelas

texts.title_ja: フアン・ラモン・ヒメネス「望まれる神」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Dios del venir, te siento entre mis manos,
aquí estás enredado conmigo, en lucha hermosa

texts.title_ja: ウナムーノ「ベラスケスのキリスト」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
¿Qué es tu vida, alma mía?, ¿cuál tu pago?
¡Lluvia en el lago!
¿Qué es tu vida, alma mía?, ¿es soledad?
